name: Attractor Transition Dynamics
description: Models how the constraint-valuation system transitions between attractor states (rasa). Captures hysteresis, basin escape, and transition paths in the CVA state space. Predicts that aesthetic experiences involve controlled transitions between rasa attractors.
theoretical_basis: Kelso (1995) on dynamic patterns in biological coordination
Haken (1983) on synergetics and order parameters
Thelen & Smith (1994) on dynamic systems in development

key_properties.hysteresis: System resists transitions until perturbation exceeds basin boundary
key_properties.critical_slowing: Approach to basin boundary shows characteristic deceleration
key_properties.bistability: Near basin boundaries, system can occupy either attractor
key_properties.transition_cost: Energy required to escape current attractor basin

basis: Synthesizes attractor dynamics from dynamical systems theory with CVA emotional state space
derivation: Emotional states are modeled as attractors in CVA space; transitions between rasas follow energy landscapes
